major_cooldowns.name: Tranquility
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Ramp with Wild Growth and as many Regrowth heal-over-time effects as you can, then channel it on the fight's most dangerous moment so every one of them gets extended.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id seen in 5/5 sampled parses; tooltip duration 6s from the ability table.

major_cooldowns.name: Convoke the Spirits
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast Wild Growth first, then send it in caster form in raid, or in Cat Form in dungeons when the group is safe and you want damage.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Guide text cites 323764, which is not observed; 391528 is the cast id in 5/5 sampled parses.

major_cooldowns.name: Incarnation: Tree of Life
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it 10-12 seconds before major damage so you can spam discounted Rejuvenations, and channel Tranquility inside it since that pauses the tree duration.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Base tooltip cooldown is 180s; the guide states Grove Guardian cooldown reduction brings it to about 1:40 with good play. Not observed in the sampled parses, which ran the Convoke build.

major_cooldowns.name: Nature's Swiftness
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Self-cast it into Regrowth on dangerous damage with Overgrowth, since it refreshes your own heal-over-time effects and splashes your other Regrowth targets.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id in 5/5 parses; the same name also exists as 378081, which is not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Innervate
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it during a heavy healing stretch and spend the free mana on Wild Growth and Regrowth rather than banking it.

defensives.name: Barkskin
defensives.usage_rule: Press it on any avoidable hit or rolling damage on you, since it costs no global cooldown and never interrupts your healing.

defensives.name: Survival Instincts
defensives.usage_rule: Save it for the single biggest hit you have to eat and pair it with a heal on yourself.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

defensives.name: Ironbark
defensives.usage_rule: Put it on the tank or whoever is about to take a big hit, and keep it moving so it is never idle through a damage window.

defensives.name: Renewal
defensives.usage_rule: Press it when your own health dips low so you can keep healing the group instead of stopping to heal yourself.
defensives.id_note: Same name as 283762; neither was pressed in the sampled parses, both castable per tooltip.

defensives.name: Cenarion Ward
defensives.usage_rule: Place it on yourself or the tank ahead of a known hit so the burst heal fires the moment damage lands.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

rules.action: Refresh Lifebloom on yourself inside its last 4.5 seconds so it blooms without ever dropping.

rules.description: Keep Efflorescence down at all times
rules.action: Drop it under your Lifebloom target, or under yourself for control, and replace it the moment it expires.

rules.description: Hold five Rejuvenations to keep Abundance up
rules.action: Batch your Rejuvenations onto the group before damage, and press Swiftmend first so the next one spreads three.

rules.description: Wild Growth before Convoke the Spirits
rules.action: Send Wild Growth first so a Flourish extension from Convoke has fresh heal-over-time effects to stretch.

rules.description: Wild Growth before your Tranquility ramp
rules.action: Ramp with Wild Growth and as many Regrowth heal-over-time effects as you can, then channel Tranquility to extend them.
Follow it immediately with Regrowth on whoever is lowest, or on yourself with Overgrowth.

source_summary: Restoration Druid stacks heal-over-time effects and then spends them: keep Lifebloom, Efflorescence and five Rejuvenations rolling so Abundance turns Regrowth into your cheap main heal, and press Swiftmend on cooldown for its blooms and procs even into full overheal. Pre-plan Tranquility and either Convoke the Spirits or Incarnation: Tree of Life onto the fight's known damage windows instead of saving them, and lead each with Wild Growth so any Flourish extension has heal-over-time effects to stretch. Nature's Swiftness into Regrowth covers spot damage, while Innervate and downtime Wrath casts fund the expensive Wild Growths.
